title: 第25章 卷入巫妖战场与大巫战祖巫第26章 后土 我偏向外人你想我巫族与三清圣人开战吗
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 洪荒大地。
一处山河中天崩地裂、日月无光。
巫妖二族的杀喊声如同雷声般滚滚，震碎山河，硝烟四起。
一头体型庞大无边的九头怪鸟身上弥漫着浓郁的水、火二道法则，火是那妖中淬炼的大妖真火、水是截取天庭天河的溺水，爆发一刻水火无情席卷四周巫族，不知多少巫族被水火卷入过后连声音都发不出来，便已经肉身消弭。
但巫族亦是来势汹汹早有准备。
竟有两尊大巫前来围杀九婴。
一尊大巫声音洪亮，手持洪荒地脉精矿以无穷浊气凝练而成的黑弓击杀妖族大军。
黑箭凝聚。
化作一条条黑龙飞出，刹那间射杀妖族军中多少妖神。
另外一尊大巫手持巨峰一样大小的拐杖如魔神下凡大开杀戒，强大的肉身与巨力根本没有任何妖族能够抵抗。
巫族来势汹汹。
令九婴无比郁闷，想要保全大军离开，但是又被缠着无法离去。
突然又有一尊大巫出现。
袭击了与弈、夸父纠缠的九婴。
九婴断裂数个脑袋，庞大身躯倒飞出去，口中发出怨毒无比的叫声：“好你个九凤，竟然敢偷袭我等，待有朝一日定来领教尔等本领！
“妖帅说要撤了！”
“快走，巫族人太多了！”
妖族大军中的妖神们疯狂呐喊。
化作一道道虹光消失在天际，留下一片片妖族大军在原地被巫族阻拦。
纵然一个个大巫们有心想将那些天庭妖神以及九婴留下，但妖族手段飞天遁地，纵使肉身崩溃元神亦能逃脱。
难以追击抹杀。
最终只能去围杀那些剩余的妖族。
妖族当即溃散，被巫族强者相继追杀。
一处高峰上。
青渊注视着数百万里外恐怖的巫妖战场，感受着那准圣恐怖气势与大道法则碰撞撼动天地，内心忌惮。
带着袁洪一众绕开巫妖战场。
只可惜。
妖族大军数量实在是太多，化作鸟兽散开之后。
天上地下、东西南北到处都是，使得也有妖族溃军逼近了青渊所在方向。
一片千数妖族溃军朝着他们方向狂奔，为首那三头怪鸟看到青渊一众后眼睛亮了，大喊道：‘道友快快出手，我等已经将巫族追兵引至此地，快伏击！
content_en:
The wild land.
In a mountain and river, the sky collapsed and the earth split, and the sun and moon lost all light.
The killing cries of the two Lich clans were like thunder, shattering the mountains and rivers, and causing smoke to rise everywhere.
A huge and boundless nine-headed strange bird is filled with the two laws of water and fire. The fire is the great demon true fire tempered among the demons, and the water is the drowning that intercepts the Tianting River. The moment it erupts, the water and fire ruthlessly sweep across the surrounding witch tribes. I don't know how many witch tribes can't even make a sound after being involved in the water and fire, and they have been physically eliminated.
But the Wu clan is also prepared for the coming.
Two great witches came to surround and kill Jiu Ying.
A great witch had a loud voice, and he was holding a black bow condensed from the essence of the ancient earth veins with infinite turbidity to kill the demon army.
The black arrows condensed.
They turned into black dragons and flew out, killing many demon gods in the demon army in an instant.
Another great witch holds a crutch the size of a giant peak and goes down to the earth like a demon to kill. His powerful body and power cannot be resisted by any demon clan.
The Witch Clan is coming menacingly.
Jiuying was extremely depressed and wanted to save the army and leave, but he was entangled and unable to leave.
Suddenly another great witch appeared.
Attacked Jiuying who was entangled with Yi and Kuafu.
Jiu Ying broke off several heads, and his huge body flew backwards. He let out an extremely vicious cry: "You Jiu Feng, how dare you sneak attack on us, I will come and learn your skills one day!"
! "
"Withdraw!
! "
"The Demon Commander said he was leaving!"
"Come on, there are too many Wu people!"
The demon gods in the demon army shouted wildly.
It turned into streaks of rainbow light and disappeared into the sky, leaving behind an army of monsters blocked by the Witch Clan.
Even though the great witches wanted to keep those heavenly demon gods and the Nine Infants behind, the demons could escape by flying to the sky and the earth, and their souls could escape even if their bodies collapsed.
Difficult to pursue and obliterate.
In the end, they could only surround and kill the remaining demon clan.
The demon clan immediately collapsed and was chased and killed by the strong men of the witch clan.
On a high peak.
Qingyuan stared at the terrifying lich battlefield millions of miles away, feeling the terrifying momentum of the quasi-sage collide with the laws of the great road to shake the world, and felt fear in his heart.
Lead Yuan Hong and others to avoid the Lich battlefield.
What a pity.
The demon army was too numerous and dispersed after turning into birds and beasts.
There were everywhere in the sky and on the ground, east, west, north and south, causing the demon clan's defeated army to approach Qingyuan's direction.
Thousands of demon clan's defeated troops were running towards them. The three strange birds in the lead's eyes lit up when they saw Qingyuan's group, and they shouted: 'Fellow Taoist, take action quickly, we have already led the Wu clan's pursuers here, ambush them quickly!
